messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['The CU CARES Act grant has applied to your spring semester account and is in the process of being refunded directly to you.', 'We were unable to process your most recent payment.', 'After the reassignment, the amount would be transferred to your bank account.', "The charge for this order will appear on your credit card statement from the merchant 'AMZN Payment Services.'", 'I want you to assist me to clear this fund out from the security company and invest it for us over there in overseas as our foreign beneficiary of the fund, and also use it for an investment purpose', 'I have the opportunity of transferring the leftover funds $8.6 million ozone of my bank deceased client who died in the charter plane which crashed on mount Kenyan in the Kenyan city of suburb on 21st july 2003 to any foreign account.', 'A money transfer has just been sent to ...', "The charge for this order will appear on your credit card statement from the merchant 'AMZN Payment Services.'", 'the South African Government will pay upfront the approved project cost of Euro 62,171,776.00BEFORE THE START OF THE CONTRACT PROJECT.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We discuss payments, refunds, bank transfers, card charges, and project funding, alongside proposals to move or invest substantial funds internationally."}
